purpose: Additional targeted search for a directly identifiable, authoritative exterior facade or entrance source after independent grade R6 identified the facade criterion as the only blocking criterion.
queries: site:purdue.edu "Animal Holding Facility" Purdue exterior photo
Purdue Animal Holding Facility 410 S University Street image
site:aphis.usda.gov Purdue "410 South University" inspection photos
Purdue AHF Animal Holding Facility APHIS inspection photos 410 South University St
USDA APHIS inspection photo "Animal Holding Facility" Purdue

findings.source: Purdue Campus Facilities and Buildings Historic Database, Animal Holding Facility record
findings.provider: Purdue University Libraries Archives and Special Collections
findings.retrieval: Search results reconfirm two dated AHF footprints (1991-2001 and 2001-present) and a brief facility history. The already-saved detail record states image_url is null and contains no structure images.
findings.relevance: Authoritative identity and footprint chronology only; no facade or entrance evidence.

findings.source: Purdue Large Animal Hospital webcam grid, camera 65
findings.retrieval: Image search surfaced a dated webcam view described as overlooking the Large Animal Hospital complex from Wade Power Plant. It does not identify AHF or isolate its facade/entrance; the distance and neighboring facilities make attribution ambiguous.
findings.relevance: Excluded from AHF facade modeling. It depicts a broader veterinary complex and cannot establish which visible walls or openings belong to AHF.

findings.source: Purdue Small Animal Hospital webcam grid, camera 70
findings.retrieval: Image results identify the view as the Small Animal Hospital, not the Animal Holding Facility.
findings.relevance: Excluded as an image of a different building.

findings.source: Purdue College of Veterinary Medicine emergency building plan for Veterinary Laboratory Animal Building (VLAB)
findings.provider: Purdue University Office of Emergency Preparedness
findings.retrieval: The page identifies VLAB at 400 S University Street and lists a room in AHF as an office location. It contains no AHF-specific exterior image or elevation.
findings.relevance: Confirms nearby facility naming/context only; it does not show AHF's facade or entrance.

findings.source: USDA APHIS Animal Care public search and Purdue inspection-record search results
findings.provider: USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service; ARLO search index
findings.retrieval: Search results establish that Purdue has public animal-research inspection records, but no returned record or image specifically identifies the exterior of AHF. The ARLO listing is campus-wide and does not distinguish buildings in imagery.
findings.relevance: No identifiable exterior evidence was retrieved; inspection records were not used to infer facade details.

findings.source: Purdue College of Veterinary Medicine and Purdue University search results for the newer veterinary hospital complex
findings.provider: Purdue University College of Veterinary Medicine; Pepper Construction
findings.retrieval: Search results include photographs and imagery of the 2020-2022 Brunner Veterinary Medical Hospital construction, plus a 2019 parking notice that names AHF. The photographs depict other named hospital buildings and do not identify AHF's facade.
findings.relevance: Excluded from AHF modeling to avoid transferring details from adjacent or replacement facilities.

decision: No directly identifiable authoritative AHF facade photograph, entrance view, elevation, or plan was found. The additional results are ambiguous broad-complex imagery, other buildings, or identity/context records. Do not add facade, doors, windows, materials, or entrance geometry based on these results. Existing R6 geometry remains the most source-supported representation; no model or builder script was changed.
next_step: Keep the asset pending. An item-level scan from Purdue University Architect records UA 154, Series 1, Sub-Series 4, File 13 or an AHF-specific current exterior view is needed to support the missing facade criterion.
limitations: Search-engine coverage is not exhaustive and does not substitute for inspection of non-digitized or access-controlled archival records.
